description: Probability of pulling at least one secret across N blind boxes at printed odds of 1-in-oddsN, plus the box counts a 50% and 90% chance require. Independent single-box model — sealed whole-case allocation can differ, and the result carries that caveat.

boxes.description: Number of blind boxes to be opened, e.g. 12

oddsN.description: The N in printed odds 1:N, e.g. 72

name: secret_pull_probability
